back through Els Secans → Valmayor IV is 33 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

places-valmayor-iv-hocino-de-chornas.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-valmayor-iv-hocino-de-chornas.story: A 296 km round trip from Nonaspe - roughly 5 h 06 in the saddle. On the way it passes Els Secans, Abric del mas de Barberà, Los Estrechos I and Hocino de Chornas. The highest point is about 1,200 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
